n: DFRobot micro:Maqueen Plus V2 with HuskyLens
t: A micro:bit robot car sold with a HuskyLens AI camera for object and line tracking.
steps: Find the micro:Maqueen Plus V2 bundle with HuskyLens on the DFRobot site.
Check whether the bundle includes a micro:bit V2 and batteries.
Assemble the robot and insert the micro:bit and batteries.
Mount the HuskyLens on the car.
Open MakeCode or Mind+ and connect the micro:bit by USB.
Follow the DFRobot AI car tutorial.
